Name: Place Lamps Outside (Furniture Anywhere Redux) by glymr
Author: glymr
TagLine: This mod will allow you to place any vanilla lamp from the furniture catalog outside. This includes the Country Lamp, the Box Lamp, the Modern Lamp, the Classic Lamp, the Candle Lamp, and the Ornate Lamp. Works with Alternative Textures and CP.
Description:
I was frustrated at not being able to place furniture outside, and the mod that used to allow it was no longer updated.

This mod allows the player to place any vanilla lamp outside. It currently affects these lamps:

    Country Lamp
    Box Lamp
    Modern Lamp
    Classic Lamp
    Candle Lamp
    Ornate Lamp


Yes, it works with Alternative Textures and Content Patcher! If you have a different skin for any of these lamps, it should show up in the game! The lamps do light up automatically when it gets dark, the same as when they're inside.

If there is interest, I would like to create more mods that allow the placement of Vanilla furniture outside. If I try to do the entire furniture catalog at once, I know I will never finish, but I can do a few at a time or a category at a time. Therefore, if there is a particular item or set of items you would like to be able to place outside, please leave a polite request in the comments and I will see about making them work. (Some items can already be placed outside, so please verify that you can't before asking.)

If you like this mod, I hope you will endorse it. Thank you!

---

Special thanks to Dr. Elizabeth MathPerson on the main Stardew Valley Discord, who suggested using Text Operations to code this since Target Field couldn't work.

For players who use a language other than English: I think the method I used should not affect the non-English Display Name property. However, if you play Stardew in a language other than English and if you have problems with this mod - for example, if the name of the lamp is wrong in the furniture catalog or if SMAPI gives an error - PLEASE let me know. It is hard for me to test in other languages, so your help would be appreciated!
